object_description: large independent square building volume with differentiated height development
design_condition: The volume is placed around the connecting green space with controlled distance from the existing complex and differentiated heights, but its scale overwhelms the pavilion ensemble and compresses the surrounding open space.

positive.statement: The careful site analysis provides a coherent conceptual starting point.

position.rationale: The conceptual site relationship is approximated in the open southern zone around the independent volume.

positive.statement: The existing construction period and delicate facade expression are preserved with care.

position.rationale: The existing facade is not separately identifiable, so the northern perimeter provides a constrained anchor.

positive.statement: The learning landscape and flexible classroom divisions are pedagogically valuable.

position.rationale: The layered interior-facing zone is used as a constrained anchor for learning-space organization.

positive.statement: The open ground floor is inviting and the spatial layers are well connected.

position.rationale: The central void and lower elevation bands visibly support an open, connected ground-floor anchor.

positive.statement: The project achieves effective summer heat protection and night cooling.

position.target: summer heat protection and night cooling
position.rationale: The performance judgment has no uniquely locatable geometric referent in the sampled model.

negative.statement: The large volume exceeds the scale of the pavilion school and puts pressure on the external space.

position.rationale: The large square mass is clearly visible across the top and elevation views.

negative.statement: The outdoor-space design disregards the garden-monument qualities and fragments the generous lawn.

position.rationale: The lawn criticism is assigned to the southwestern open-space region surrounding the building.

negative.statement: The large atrium is acoustically unsuitable for school use by this age group.

position.rationale: The central atrium is visibly distinguished by the surrounding perimeter and layered elevation pattern.

negative.statement: The interventions in the existing structure and surfaces are far too massive.

position.rationale: Existing interventions are approximated along the northern edge where the surrounding complex would connect.

negative.statement: The building has poor economic characteristics and is the most expensive new building.

position.rationale: The cost comparison is an overall performance judgment without a useful spatial referent.
